test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 26th July 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Directions: Given below are six sentences A-F, of which A and F are static and B-E have been jumbled. Pick the option that gives the correct order of the jumbled sentences.**

A. A singer called Mukandan Misra and his wife lived in Behat near Gwalior.

B. Tired, the group settled down to rest in a shady grove.

C. Once Swami Haridas was traveling through the forest with his disciples.

D. Tansen, their only child was very naughty.

E. Often he would run away to the woods and soon learned to imitate the calls of birds and animals.

F. Tansen thought it would be fun to frighten the resting men with the roar of a tiger.
solution:
The correct answer is 'ADECBF'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence 'A' is independent of any other sentence as it is giving general information about "**a singer** **Mukandan Misra and his wife**". Hence, 'A' is the first part.
 
• Sentence D will come after A because it explains the habit of the only child of the couple.
 
• Sentence E will come after D because it explains what did the child often used to do.
 
• Sentence C will come after E because it explains **one day what happened in that forest where the child used to run away**.
 
• Sentence B will come after C because it explains **what the disciples did when felt tired**.
 
• The sentence 'F' is the concluding part because it explains **what Tansen has done with his disciples**.

 

Paragraph after rearranging the sentences__: *A singer called Mukandan Misra and his wife lived in Behat near Gwalior. Tansen, their only child was very naughty. Often he would run away to the woods and soon learned to imitate the calls of birds and animals. Once Swami Haridas was traveling through the forest with his disciples. Tired, the group settled down to rest in a shady grove. Tansen thought it would be fun to frighten the resting men with the roar of a tiger.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a6c2db12945bba9d674d33112fce66b07f00093d75dae93749f9bdb7bd34e7a.png] **__Hint__**

__
 
• Important Rules to Solve the Para Jumbles__:

 __
 
• Read the sentences attentively and try to comprehend the idea or theme of the sentence and eliminate the irrelevant options.
 
• Try to identify the opening (independent sentence) and closing sentences (concluding sentence).
 
• Try to identify the mandatory pairs. Two sentences can be connected through various connectors and other determinants.

 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• वाक्य 'A' किसी अन्य वाक्य से स्वतंत्र है क्योंकि यह "एक गायक मुकंदन मिश्रा और उनकी पत्नी" के बारे में सामान्य जानकारी दे रहा है। अतः 'A' पहला भाग है।
 
• वाक्य D, A के बाद आएगा क्योंकि यह मुकंदन मिश्रा और उनकी पत्नी की इकलौती संतान की आदत की व्याख्या करता है।
 
• वाक्य E, D के बाद आएगा क्योंकि यह बताता है कि बच्चा अक्सर क्या करता था।
 
• वाक्य C, E के बाद आएगा क्योंकि यह बताता है कि एक दिन उस जंगल में क्या हुआ जहां बच्चा भागता था।
 
• वाक्य B, C के बाद आएगा क्योंकि यह बताता है कि शिष्यों ने थकान महसूस होने पर क्या किया।
 
• वाक्य 'F' अंतिम भाग है क्योंकि यह बताता है कि तानसेन ने अपने शिष्यों के साथ क्या किया है।

91:T3aad,

The correct answer is **He said that Manan had come to college the previous day**.
